name: Living Network
line: The real cancer network from graph.json grown as a dandelion-like plant: a stem rises, fourteen organ-system branches unfold to 68 cancer buds, 469 links reach out to 185 exposure leaves coloured by IARC group, and the whole plant sways very slightly; hover any leaf or bud for its name.
notes: Both Hedvig families have one weight and no italic (font-synthesis is off, so nothing is faked) and no Cyrillic. The tools' small plants are inline SVG drawn to count (68 stems and 185 leaves; 45 stems and 124 leaves) and grow in when revealed. Without JavaScript, or if graph.json fails, media/tool-cancer-network.svg is shown in the hero instead; reduced motion draws the full plant once.
